location.location_note: City records describe the active CHI-11/C1 Yorkville campus as approximately 228 acres; earlier city materials described approximately 230 acres.

actions.government_body: United City of Yorkville City Council
actions.action_type: Planned Unit Development and preliminary PUD approval
actions.notes: Original C1 Yorkville / CyrusOne CHI-11 PUD was approved for a data-center campus and on-site substation; Yorkville's archived data-center petition table lists Ordinances 2024-31 and 2024-33 for Cyrus One Phase 1, and the city's 2026 sound consultant memo states the original PUD was approved on July 9, 2024.

actions.government_body: United City of Yorkville City Council
actions.notes: City archive lists the 2026 Cyrus One Phase 1 minor PUD amendment as Ordinance 2026-09. The request revised the approved substation footprint/location and eliminated Building 7 from the plan, reducing total building area to 2,163,800 sq ft.

actions.government_body: United City of Yorkville Economic Development Committee
actions.notes: C1 Yorkville submitted a major amendment/preliminary PUD plan for the Cyrus One CHI-11 campus to reduce the approved plan from nine two-story buildings totaling approximately 2,451,200 sq ft to eight one-story buildings with a maximum footprint of approximately 2,163,800 sq ft.

actions.government_body: C1 Yorkville / United City of Yorkville submittal
actions.result_status: 480 MW allocated; 174 MW supplemental requested; future design load not fully allocated
actions.notes: Petitioner's power letter says 480 MW has been allocated to date, C1 has executed necessary documentation and paid ComEd deposits for that allocation, allocated power is expected in tranches beginning in 2028, a 174 MW supplemental allocation was requested in April 2026, and the current configuration could accommodate 810 MW if additional load is requested and allocated.

actions.government_body: C1 Yorkville / United City of Yorkville submittal
actions.notes: City-posted CHI-11 infrastructure phasing plan states Phase 1 commenced in Q1 2026 and is currently under construction; Phase 1 covers construction entrance and substation construction.

CyrusOne's Yorkville Technology Campus page says the project was approved by the City of Yorkville in 2024, water and sanitary improvements began in 2025, site work began in early 2026, the first building is expected to be completed in late 2027, and full operations are expected in 2028.

capacity_note: 480 MW is the power allocated to date for C1 Yorkville per the 2026-06-02 power letter. The same letter says a 174 MW supplemental allocation was requested in April 2026, the Power Bureau study modeled 654 MW, and the current building configuration could accommodate 810 MW if additional load is later requested and allocated; those higher figures are tracked as requested/future, not current allocated capacity.
owner: CyrusOne; land-use applicant/entity: C1 Yorkville, LLC

contradictions.assessment: The baseline 480 MW value is retained but rescoped from a low-confidence planning signal to allocated power for C1 Yorkville. Higher figures in 2026 materials are not contradictions: 654 MW equals 480 MW allocated plus a 174 MW supplemental request, while 810 MW is potential design accommodation if more load is later requested and allocated.

Official/developer sources support construction-level status for site/substation/infrastructure work, but not energized/live data-center operations. The first building and full operations remain forward-looking targets.

contradictions.assessment: Yorkville has multiple data-center proposals in the same corridor. The 480 MW seed value maps to C1 Yorkville / CHI-11 because the 2026 official power letter explicitly uses 480 MW for C1 Yorkville. Project Cardinal and Project Steel are separate records/proposals and are not merged here.

contradictions.new_value: Cleanview lists 600 MW and expected year 2026
contradictions.assessment: Not used for capacity/status because Yorkville's official 2026 power letter supports 480 MW allocated power, while CyrusOne states first building completion is expected in late 2027 and full operations beginning in 2028.
